name: add_user_room
signature: AddUserRoom(ctx context.Context, userID string, locationRoomID string, opts incidentiq.RequestOptions, out any) error
summary: Adds one location-room association to a user. Rejects a request body and disables the Silver retry-without-Client fallback so an ambiguous rejection cannot duplicate the write.

name: remove_user_room
signature: RemoveUserRoom(ctx context.Context, userID string, locationRoomID string, opts incidentiq.RequestOptions, out any) error
summary: Removes one location-room association from a user.

name: set_user_rooms
signature: SetUserRooms(ctx context.Context, userID string, locationRoomIDs []string, opts incidentiq.RequestOptions, out any) error
summary: Replaces every location-room association for a user. The method owns the JSON body, so a nil slice is rejected and an empty non-nil slice clears all associations.
